apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: Saving and avatar upload go through server actions and mutation hooks that surface their own failures; the step renders no distinct offline layout.

apps/web/components/features/demo/Onboar.empty: The demo flow renders fixed fixture data with no fetch, user input beyond a local handle, or failure path, so this state cannot occur.
apps/web/components/features/demo/Onboar.error: The demo flow renders fixed fixture data with no fetch, user input beyond a local handle, or failure path, so this state cannot occur.
apps/web/components/features/demo/Onboar.offline: The demo flow renders fixed fixture data with no fetch, user input beyond a local handle, or failure path, so this state cannot occur.
apps/web/components/features/demo/Onboar.long-content: The demo flow renders fixed fixture data with no fetch, user input beyond a local handle, or failure path, so this state cannot occur.

apps/web/components/features/home/Market.empty: Each surface id always renders a populated showcase crop; there is no empty data state to show.

apps/web/components/features/home/claim-.permission-denied: The form never gates on permission: signed-out visitors are sent to signup on submit and signed-in users go straight to onboarding, so there is no denied UI.

apps/web/components/onboarding/Onboardin.permission-denied: The modal opens only for an already authenticated onboarding session (initialRequested comes from the app route); it has no denied UI.
